description: ScraperSocial provides an API for retrieving publicly available data from social, video, commerce, maps, and developer platforms, including transcripts, summaries, profiles, posts, comments, reviews, and search results. It also offers an MCP server that exposes this data surface as tools for AI agents.
summary: ScraperSocial exposes a bearer-authenticated REST API at `api.scrapersocial.com` and an OAuth-or-bearer protected streamable-HTTP MCP server at `mcp.scrapersocial.com`; no GraphQL API or standalone CLI was found.
